cards.name: Tragic Arrogance
cards.oracleText: For each player, you choose from among the permanents that player controls an artifact, a creature, an enchantment, and a planeswalker. Then each player sacrifices all other nonland permanents they control.

cards.name: Tragic Slip
cards.oracleText:
Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
Morbid — That creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead if a creature died this turn.

cards.name: Tragic Lesson
cards.oracleText: Draw two cards. Then discard a card unless you return a land you control to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Tragic Poet
cards.oracleText: {T}, Sacrifice this creature: Return target enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Tragic Fall
cards.oracleText:
Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
Hellbent — That creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead if you have no cards in hand.

cards.name: Tragic Banshee
cards.oracleText: Morbid — When this creature enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn. If a creature died this turn, that creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead.

cards.name: Tragedy Feaster
cards.oracleText:
Trample
Ward—Discard a card.
Infusion — At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice a permanent unless you gained life this turn.

cards.name: Tragda, the Burner
cards.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever a land card is put into a graveyard from anywhere, put two +1/+1 counters on Tragda.
Whenever Tragda attacks, choose one—
• Burn the village — Destroy target land.
• Burn the peasants — Tragda deals 4 damage to target creature.

cards.name: Tragic Trajectory
cards.oracleText:
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
Void — That creature gets -10/-10 until end of turn instead if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.
